scope: execution-driven two-core single-writer HUSH subset, independently written cycle-level model; not gem5; registered configuration with one-cycle WU backpressure on a coincident commit
cache_model: four dedicated receiver slots, no replacement; writer retains authoritative data
arbitration: two-client nonpreemptive round robin; a pending miss blocks new private-store admission, waits at most one existing one-cycle private store, then reserves shared responsibility
selection: dynamic finite-domain enumeration; fixed baseline exhaustively scans all 255 legal loads. Admit with phase-independent relative-age bound, select two-task makespan at phi=0.
report: real cycles in this architecture model, reader bound/observed time, writer completion, makespan, misses, update packets/deliveries, safe-hit errors; retain regressions and empty feasible sets
bootstrap_case: BSQ: four cold reads, 32 steady reads, then one read and private compute; same four blocks and CPU gap4
guard_reason: make the service contract independent of a positive writer compute gap; retain old model and a zero-gap negative control
config_interlock: A completed phase write blocks same-cycle WU delivery; retain that WU and occupy server for one extra cycle. Existing timers are unchanged. A resident capture is still after decrement.
